lessons_used: No clear effect has been seen for any kind of change tested so far, as no individual test yielded a significant win.
No clear effect was seen for adoption redesigns or choose_path copy changes across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for finish notifications, finish new screens, home notifications, home wait info, sign-in copy, and sign-in reordering, as only one test has been conducted per category.
Predictions were systematically too high across Round 1 tests compared to measured outcomes.

candidates.title: Preset Pet Quick Choice Flow
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen into a split layout with clear visual cards comparing instant starter pets against custom pet creation.
candidates.why: choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate and high mean completion time (514s); clear interactive split cards reduce decision friction.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Meet Your Desktop Pet
choose_path.body: Select a quick starter pet or build your own custom companion from scratch.

guard.reason: Redesign retains both adoption and custom pet creation choices on the choose path screen.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesigns showed negative results in prior tests (-0.7%), high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Pre-Sign-In Account Recovery Note
candidates.change: Add explicit hint text on the sign-in screen explaining how signing into an existing account restores saved desktop pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Already have pets? Sign in with your original account to restore your existing desktop companions.

guard.reason: Sign-in hint provides account recovery context without violating pricing or onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in copy changes showed +2.1% lift previously.

candidates.title: Pet Desktop Placement Preview Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new interactive desktop simulator screen right before home intro to demonstrate where the pet lives on the desktop.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and support received 3 complaints about pets not displaying on the desktop.

new_desktop_sim.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
new_desktop_sim.body: Your pet resides active on your desktop screen margin.

guard.reason: Adding a new desktop simulation screen inside onboarding before home intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen to finish step previously yielded -0.1% lift and increases friction.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Quiz Flow
candidates.change: Add a short quiz screen before pet selection to help guide hesitant users toward their ideal pet match.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a long median duration of 89s, indicating indecision during selection.

new_quiz_screen.headline: Find Your Companion Match
new_quiz_screen.body: Answer 2 quick questions to discover your recommended pet style.

guard.reason: Adding a quiz sub-flow inside onboarding is permitted and does not skip required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has high dropoff, but adoption redesigns failed (-0.9%) and adding quiz screens adds friction.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Spotlight Layout
candidates.change: Re-layout home intro with a spotlight design highlighting shortcut controls for hiding, dragging, and interacting with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails asking how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Essential Desktop Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to minimize, feed, or start a talk.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro layout is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 3 support tickets with a layout update at moderate cost.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Display live image quality guidance hints on the photo upload screen to prevent failed avatar generations.
candidates.why: Support received 3 bug reports about custom pet generation failing or rendering wrong.

upload_photos.hint: Upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward for best custom pet generation.

guard.reason: asks for personal photos/information of the user

candidates.title: Interactive Story Scroll Waiting Room
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a story scroll layout featuring pet trick demonstrations while background assets finalize.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high median duration (201s) and mean duration (2336s), causing drop-off.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Scroll through pet tricks while we finalize your desktop experience.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen maintains its job of indicating the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Home wait info changes previously lost conversion (-1.9%), and full screen redesign is high cost.

candidates.title: Post-Certificate Sign-In Move
candidates.change: Move sign-in after adoption certificate step so users complete pet adoption before creating or verifying an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% early on; deferring sign-in until after adoption builds investment first.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after the adoption certificate is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering previously had a mild positive outcome (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Desktop Ready System Notification
candidates.change: Enable system readiness notification alert switch on the waiting screen to inform users when background setup finishes.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pet not appearing or app failing to launch during long setup waits.

waiting.hint: We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready.

guard.reason: Enabling ready notifications on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low cost config change; home notifications showed +2.5% in prior test and addresses 3 support mails.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Onboarding Story Kickoff
candidates.change: Switch the introductory story screen to full_bleed layout to establish app value before path selection.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path before initiating pet adoption.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion
story.body: Bring interactive fun and helpful shortcuts directly to your desktop workspace.

guard.reason: Story screen layout change preserves its job of introducing the pet companion.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path changes have consistently shown no positive effect across tests.

lessons_next: Choose_path redesign produced the first significant win, but evidence remains thin as only one test of this kind has been run.
No clear effect was seen for adoption redesigns or choose_path copy changes across multiple tests.
Sign-in reordering showed no clear effect in its first test and caused a significant drop in its second test.
Evidence remains thin for finish notifications, finish new screens, finish layouts, home wait info, and sign-in copy changes due to having only one test each.
Predictions were systematically too high across Round 1 tests compared to measured outcomes.
Predictions were too low for the choose_path redesign test, which was predicted to decrease performance (-0.5%) but resulted in a significant win (+6.6%).
